title: Reference oracle gaps
description: The kernel vectors to which the reference oracle, python-jsonschema with the format checkers tools/oracle/requirements.txt pins, gives a verdict other than the stated one, each under a numbered gap with the reason. The kernel-engines gate fails on a disagreement this file doesn't list, on a listed one that no longer occurs, and on a file written for other versions than the pins.

oracle.description: The packages and versions the gaps were checked against, as `jsonschema 4.26.0, rfc3339-validator 0.1.4`. Each must be the pinned one.

reason.description: What the oracle does that gives the vector another verdict, and which standard says the stated one.

vectors.description: The vectors it covers, each by its primitive, its value, and the verdict the oracle gives.

oracle.description: The oracle's verdict, which the stated one isn't.
